```plato

// A half-line in space: starts at Origin and extends along Direction only.
// The point at parameter t >= 0 is Origin + Direction * t.
type Ray3D
    implements IGeometry3D, IConnected, INearestPoint3D
{
    Origin: Point3D;
    Direction: Direction3D;
}
```
